name.description: The party's name. Only present when the name is available and privacy is not enabled.

number.description: The party's number. Only present when the number is available and privacy is not enabled. The number can be digits or a URI. Some examples for number include: `1234`, `2223334444`, `+12223334444`, `*73`, `user@company.domain`

personId.description: The party's person ID. Only present when the person ID is available and privacy is not enabled.

placeId.description: The party's place ID. Only present when the place ID is available and privacy is not enabled.

privacyEnabled.description: Indicates whether privacy is enabled for the name, number and personId/placeId.

callType.description: The call type for the party.

CallTypeEnum.description:
* `location` - The party is within the same location.
 * `organization` - The party is within the same organization but not within the same location.
 * `external` - The party is outside the organization.
 * `emergency` - The party is an emergency call destination.
 * `repair` - The party is a repair call destination.
 * `other` - The party does not belong to one of the defined call types. For example, a call to a Call Forwarding Always feature activation code.
